tools.name: modelfinder_audit_models
tools.description: List AI model IDs (quoted literals) and AI SDKs used in the repository, with file:line locations, provider family, route hints (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure, OpenRouter), usage counts and whether each ID is hard-coded or an environment-variable default. Read-only; skips secret-like files and dependency folders; never returns line content. Results are sorted by usage and paginated.

path.description: Directory inside the workspace, relative to the project root (e.g. "services/api"). Defaults to the project root. If a call fails because the project is unknown, pass the absolute path of the project (your current working directory).

offset.description: Items to skip; use next_offset from the previous page.

provider_family.description: Only models from this family, e.g. "anthropic".

hard_coded_only.description: Only IDs not read from configuration or environment.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.name: modelfinder_draft_eval_examples
tools.description: Draft eval examples from prompt files and fixtures (prompts/, evals/, fixtures/, *.prompt.md, and JSON/JSONL with input, prompt or chat messages). Drops any candidate with detected personal data or secrets and reports only categories and counts. Drafts have empty checks: agree checks with the user before modelfinder_create_eval_config. Paginated; ids are stable across pages.

path.description: Directory inside the workspace, relative to the project root (e.g. "services/api"). Defaults to the project root. If a call fails because the project is unknown, pass the absolute path of the project (your current working directory).

offset.description: Items to skip; use next_offset from the previous page.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

annotations.title: Draft eval examples from the repo

tools.title: Draft eval examples from the repo

tools.name: modelfinder_create_eval_config
tools.description: Assemble an eval config from candidate models, examples with checks, and settings; validate it and screen the examples for personal data and secrets. Returns the config to save as JSON for eval_models.py. Keys are referenced by environment variable name only.

task.description: One-line description of what the model must do.

provider.description: API format. Use openai_compatible for OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM or gateways.

model.description: Exact provider model ID, verified from official docs.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key, never the key.

base_url.description: HTTPS endpoint (http only for localhost). Required for openai_compatible.

price_per_million.description: {input, output, cached_input?, source, checked} in USD per million tokens from the official pricing page, or null if not verified.

examples.description: Inputs with the checks each reply must pass.

checks.description: Deterministic checks; all must pass. Types: contains, not_contains, exact (value, ignore_case?), regex (pattern), json_keys (keys), max_chars (value). Example: [{"type": "json_keys", "keys": ["category"]}, {"type": "contains", "value": "refund"}]

value.description: String for contains/not_contains/exact; positive integer for max_chars.

keys.description: Required top-level JSON keys for json_keys.

pass_threshold.description: Share of calls that must pass every check (0-1).

repeats.description: Runs per example (3+ for noisy tasks).

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Create an eval config

tools.name: modelfinder_validate_eval_config
tools.description: Check an eval config before running: schema, no keys in the config, HTTPS endpoints, no template placeholders, valid checks. Reports API call count, required environment variable names, unpriced models, and whether the personal-data guard would block the run. Makes no network calls.

config.description: The eval config object (as saved for eval_models.py).

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Validate an eval config

tools.name: modelfinder_check_output
tools.description: Run deterministic checks on one model reply. Use it to design eval checks and routing guards before spending money on a run.

checks.description: Deterministic checks; all must pass. Types: contains, not_contains, exact (value, ignore_case?), regex (pattern), json_keys (keys), max_chars (value). Example: [{"type": "json_keys", "keys": ["category"]}, {"type": "contains", "value": "refund"}]

value.description: String for contains/not_contains/exact; positive integer for max_chars.

keys.description: Required top-level JSON keys for json_keys.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Test a reply against checks

tools.name: modelfinder_rank_eval_results
tools.description: Read a results.json object and return the cheapest model that met the pass threshold, ranked by cost per passing call, plus the cost/reliability cascade and models dropped as dominated.

results.description: The full results.json object written by eval_models.py.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Rank eval results

tools.name: modelfinder_generate_routing
tools.description: Turn a results.json object into a cheapest-first routing.json (with guards and a personal-data policy) and a LiteLLM proxy config. Returns both; nothing is written or deployed.

results.description: The full results.json object written by eval_models.py.

guards.description: Checks applied to every production reply; a failure escalates to the next model.

value.description: String for contains/not_contains/exact; positive integer for max_chars.

keys.description: Required top-level JSON keys for json_keys.

chain.description: Explicit model order (candidate ids), overriding cost order.

include_unknown_cost.description: Append passing models whose price is unknown.

pii_policy.description: block: never send prompts with personal data or secrets; warn: send and report; off: no check.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Generate cheapest-first routing

tools.name: modelfinder_estimate_cost
tools.description: Planning estimate of monthly token cost from requests, average tokens per request and USD-per-million prices, with optional cached-input share and pass rate (cost per accepted result, counting retries). Prices must come from the provider's official pricing page.

output_tokens.description: Average output tokens per request (include reasoning tokens).

cached_fraction.description: Share of input tokens billed at the cached rate (0-1).

pass_rate.description: Optional eval pass rate; failures are assumed retried.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Estimate monthly token cost

tools.name: modelfinder_estimate_memory
tools.description: Estimate memory to run an open-weight model locally: weights at a precision plus KV cache for a context length and concurrency (standard MHA/GQA attention only), with headroom against available memory. Give all four of layers, kv_heads, head_dim and context to include the KV cache.

params_b.description: Total stored parameters in billions (for MoE, all experts).

bits.description: Effective bits per weight: 16, 8, about 4.5 for common 4-bit formats.

context.description: Context tokens per sequence actually used.

available_gib.description: GPU or unified memory available, in GiB.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.

tools.title: Estimate local model memory

tools.name: modelfinder_scan_sensitive_data
tools.description: Detect Aadhaar (Verhoeff checked), PAN, payment cards (Luhn checked), email addresses, UPI IDs, Indian mobile numbers and API or private keys in text. Returns categories and counts only, never the values.

text.description: Text to scan, up to 1,000,000 characters.

response_format.description: markdown (default) for a readable summary, json for the full machine-readable result.
